name: DescribeDisks

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the block storage device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 块存储所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of disks, local disks, or elastic ephemeral disks. The value is a JSON array that can contain up to 100 IDs. Separate the IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 云盘、本地盘或弹性临时盘ID。一个带有格式的JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: disk_ids

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance to which the disk, local disk, or elastic ephemeral disk is attached
parameters.help_zh: 云盘、本地盘或弹性临时盘挂载的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the disk, local disk, or elastic ephemeral disk to query. Valid values: 
         
all: queries both system disks and data disks.
system: queries only system disks.
data: queries only data disks.

Default value: all.
Elastic ephemeral disks cannot be used as system disks
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的云盘、本地盘或弹性临时盘类型。取值范围： 
         
all：同时查询系统盘与数据盘。
system：只查询系统盘。
data：只查询数据盘。

默认值：all。
弹性临时盘不支持作为系统盘
parameters.name: disk_type

parameters.help_en:
The category of the disk. Valid values: 
         
all: all disks, local disks, and elastic ephemeral disks.
cloud: basic disk.
cloud_efficiency: ultra disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
cloud_essd: enterprise SSD (ESSD).
cloud_auto: ESSD AutoPL disk.
cloud_regional_disk_auto: regional ESSD.
cloud_essd_entry: ESSD Entry disk.
elastic_ephemeral_disk_standard: elastic ephemeral disk - standard.
elastic_ephemeral_disk_premium: elastic ephemeral disk - premium.
local_ssd_pro: I/O-intensive local disk.
local_hdd_pro: throughput-intensive local disk.
ephemeral: (retired) local disk.
ephemeral_ssd: (retired) local SSD.

Default value: all
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘种类。取值范围： 
         
all：所有云盘以及本地盘和弹性临时盘。
cloud：普通云盘。
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD盘。
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘。
cloud_auto：ESSD AutoPL云盘。
cloud_regional_disk_auto：ESSD 同城冗余云盘。
cloud_essd_entry：ESSD Entry云盘。
elastic_ephemeral_disk_standard：弹性临时盘-标准版。
elastic_ephemeral_disk_premium：弹性临时盘-高级版。
local_ssd_pro：I/O密集型本地盘。
local_hdd_pro：吞吐密集型本地盘。
ephemeral：（已停售）本地盘。
ephemeral_ssd：（已停售）本地SSD盘。

默认值：all
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The status of the disk. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25689.html. Valid values:
In_use: in use.
Available: to be attached.
Attaching: being attached.
Detaching: being detached.
Creating: being created.
ReIniting: being initialized.
All: all statuses.

Default value: All
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘状态。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25689.html。取值范围：
In_use：使用中。
Available：待挂载。
Attaching：挂载中 。
Detaching：卸载中。
Creating：创建中。
ReIniting：初始化中。
All：所有状态。

默认值：All
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the snapshot used to create the disk
parameters.help_zh: 创建云盘时使用的快照ID
parameters.name: snapshot_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the disk is removable. Valid values:

true: The disk is removable. The disk can exist independently and can be freely attached to or detached from instances within the same zone.

false: The disk is not removable. The disk cannot exist independently and cannot be freely attached to or detached from instances within the same zone.

The Portable attribute of the following types of block storage devices is false, and their lifecycle is the same as that of the associated instance:

Local disks.
Local SSDs.
Subscription data disks
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘是否支持卸载。取值范围：

true：支持。可以独立存在，且可以在可用区内自由挂载和卸载。

false：不支持。不可以独立存在，且不可以在可用区内自由挂载和卸载。

以下类型块存储的`Portable`属性都为`false`，生命周期与实例等同：

本地盘。
本地SSD盘。
包年包月数据盘
parameters.name: portable

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the disk is released when the associated instance is released. Valid values:

true: The disk is released when the associated instance is released.
false: The disk is retained and converted to a pay-as-you-go data disk when the associated instance is released.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘是否设置了随实例释放。取值范围：

true：磁盘随实例一起释放。
false：磁盘保留不释放，转为按量付费数据盘而保留下来。

默认值：false
parameters.name: delete_with_instance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether automatic snapshots are released when the disk is released.

true: Automatic snapshots are released.

false: Automatic snapshots are not released.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
释放云盘时，是否会同时释放自动快照。

true：是。

false：否。

默认值：false
parameters.name: delete_auto_snapshot

parameters.help_en: This parameter will be offline soon. Use NextToken and MaxResults for paging operations
parameters.help_zh: 该参数即将下线，推荐您使用参数 `NextToken `与 `MaxResults `完成分页查询操作
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: This parameter will be offline soon. Use NextToken and MaxResults for paging operations
parameters.help_zh: 该参数即将下线，推荐您使用参数 `NextToken `与 `MaxResults `完成分页查询操作
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

For information about how to view the returned data, see the operation description section above
parameters.help_zh:
查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次调用API返回的`NextToken`参数值。

有关本接口查看返回数据的设置方式，请参见上文接口说明部分
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 10 to 500.

Default value:
If this parameter is not specified or is set to a value less than 10, the default value is 10.
If this parameter is set to a value greater than 500, the default value is 500
parameters.help_zh:
返回的最大数。取值范围：10~500。

默认值：
当不设置值或者设置的值小于10，默认值为10。
当设置的值大于500时，默认值为500
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The name of the disk. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and characters categorized as letter in Unicode. The name can contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 磁盘的名称。长度为2~128个字符，支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: disk_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy used to query disks
parameters.help_zh: 根据自动快照策略ID查询云盘
parameters.name: auto_snapshot_policy_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the automatic snapshot policy feature is enabled for the disk.

true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled.

This parameter is deprecated. After a disk is created, the automatic snapshot policy feature is enabled by default. You only need to associate an automatic snapshot policy with the disk
parameters.help_zh:
云盘是否启用自动快照策略功能。

true：启用。
false：未启用。

该参数已弃用。创建后的云盘默认启用自动快照策略功能，您只需要为云盘绑定自动快照策略即可正常使用
parameters.name: enable_auto_snapshot

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether an automatic snapshot policy is applied to the disk.
true: An automatic snapshot policy is applied.
false: No automatic snapshot policy is applied.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
云盘是否设置了自动快照策略。
true：已设置。
false：未设置。

默认值：false
parameters.name: enable_automated_snapshot_policy

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the disk. Valid values:

PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘的计费方式。取值范围：

PrePaid：包年包月。
PostPaid：按量付费
parameters.name: disk_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The reason why the disk is locked. Valid values:

financial: The disk is locked due to overdue payments.
security: The disk is locked for security reasons
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘被锁定的原因。取值范围：

financial：因欠费被锁定。
security：因安全原因被锁定
parameters.name: lock_reason

parameters.help_en: The filter key used to query resources. Set the value to `CreationStartTime`. You can specify both Filter.1.Key and Filter.1.Value to query resources that were created after the specified point in time
parameters.help_zh: 查询资源时的筛选键，取值必须为`CreationStartTime`。同时设置`Filter.1.Key`和`Filter.1.Value`可以查询在指定时间点后创建的资源信息
parameters.name: filter_1_key

parameters.help_en: The filter key used to query resources. Set the value to `CreationEndTime`. You can specify both Filter.2.Key and Filter.2.Value to query resources that were created before the specified point in time
parameters.help_zh: 查询资源时的筛选键，取值必须为`CreationEndTime`。同时设置`Filter.2.Key`和`Filter.2.Value`可以查询在指定时间点前创建的资源信息
parameters.name: filter_2_key

parameters.help_en: The filter value used to query resources. When you specify this parameter, you must also specify the `Filter.1.Key` parameter. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC+0
parameters.help_zh: 查询资源时的筛选值。指定该参数时必须同时指定`Filter.1.Key`参数，格式为：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`，采用UTC +0时区
parameters.name: filter_1_value

parameters.help_en: The filter value used to query resources. When you specify this parameter, you must also specify the `Filter.2.Key` parameter. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC+0
parameters.help_zh: 查询资源时的筛选值。指定该参数时必须同时指定`Filter.2.Key`参数，格式为：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`，采用UTC +0时区
parameters.name: filter_2_value

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the disk belongs. When you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1,000.

Filtering by the default resource group is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘所在的企业资源组ID。使用该参数过滤资源时，资源数量不能超过1000个。

不支持默认资源组过滤
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the disk is a Shared Block Storage device
parameters.help_zh: 是否是共享块存储
parameters.name: enable_shared

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only encrypted disks.

true: Queries only encrypted disks.

false: Does not filter by encryption status.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否只筛选出加密云盘。

true：是。

false：否

默认值：false
parameters.name: encrypted

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including whether the AccessKey is valid, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and whether required parameters are specified. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false: performs a dry run and sends a Normal request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2XX HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值范围：

true：发送检查请求，不会查询资源状况。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2XX HTTP状态码并直接查询资源状况。

默认值：false
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Key Management Service (KMS) key used by the disk
parameters.help_zh: 云盘使用的KMS密钥ID
parameters.name: kms_key_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the multi-attach feature is enabled for the disk. Valid values:

Disabled: The multi-attach feature is not enabled.
Enabled: The multi-attach feature is enabled.
LegacyShared: queries Shared Block Storage devices
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启了多重挂载特性。取值范围：

Disabled：未开启。
Enabled：已开启。
LegacyShared：用于查询共享块存储
parameters.name: multi_attach

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the disk.

To improve backward compatibility, use the Tag.N.Key parameter
fields.help_zh:
磁盘的标签键。

为提高代码兼容性，请尽量使用Tag.N.Key参数
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the disk. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

If you use a single tag to filter resources, the resource count with the specified tag cannot exceed 1,000. If you use multiple tags to filter resources, the resource count with all specified tags attached cannot exceed 1,000. If the resource count exceeds 1,000, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110425.html operation
fields.help_zh:
磁盘的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。

使用一个标签过滤资源，查询到该标签下的资源数量不能超过1000个；使用多个标签过滤资源，查询到同时绑定了多个标签的资源数量不能超过1000个。如果资源数量超过1000个，请使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110425.html接口进行查询
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the disk. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 磁盘的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the disk.

To improve backward compatibility, use the Tag.N.Value parameter
fields.help_zh:
磁盘的标签值。

为提高代码兼容性，请尽量使用Tag.N.Value参数
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags of the disk
parameters.help_zh: 磁盘标签列表
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The list of additional attribute values. The only valid value is `Placement`, which queries the data storage location of the disk.

Only regional ESSD (cloud_regional_disk_auto) disks have valid data storage locations
parameters.help_zh:
其他属性值列表。目前仅支持传入值为`Placement`，表示查询当前磁盘的数据存放地。

目前仅同城冗余类型的磁盘有数据存放地
parameters.name: additional_attributes

AttachedTime.description_en: The time when the disk was last attached. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC+0
AttachedTime.description_zh: 该磁盘最后一次挂载的时间。按照ISO8601标准表示，使用UTC+0时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddThh:mmZ

Attachment.description_en: The list of attachment information of the disk, consisting of Attachment objects. This list is not returned when you query Shared Block Storage devices
Attachment.description_zh: 磁盘所涉及的挂载信息。由`Attachment`对象组成的列表，查询共享块存储时不返回该列表

items.description_en: The attachment information of the disk
items.description_zh: 磁盘所涉及的挂载信息

AttachedTime.description_en: The time when the disk was attached. The time is displayed in UTC+0
AttachedTime.description_zh: 挂载的时间，以UTC +0时间为准

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the attached instance

AutoSnapshotPolicyId.description_en:
The ID of the automatic snapshot policy applied to the disk.
This parameter is being deprecated. If multiple automatic snapshot policies are applied to the disk, only one policy ID is returned. Use DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyAssociations to query all automatic snapshot policies applied to the disk
AutoSnapshotPolicyId.description_zh:
云盘采用的自动快照策略ID。
该参数即将被弃用。如果云盘应用了多条自动快照策略，只会返回其中一条。建议您使用DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyAssociations查询云盘应用的所有自动快照策略

BdfId.description_en: This parameter is in invitational preview and is not publicly available
BdfId.description_zh: 该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用

BurstingEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the performance burst feature is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled.

This parameter is supported only when DiskCategory is set to cloud_auto. For more information, see [ESSD AutoPL disks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html）
BurstingEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启Burst（性能突发）。可能值：

true：是。
false：否。

当`DiskCategory`取值为`cloud_auto`时才支持设置该参数。更多信息，请参见[ESSD AutoPL云盘]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html）

Category.description_en:
The category of the disk. Valid values:

cloud: basic disk.
cloud_efficiency: ultra disk. 
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
cloud_essd: enterprise SSD (ESSD).
cloud_auto: ESSD AutoPL disk.
local_ssd_pro: I/O-intensive local disk. 
local_hdd_pro: throughput-intensive local disk.
cloud_essd_entry: ESSD Entry disk.
elastic_ephemeral_disk_standard: elastic ephemeral disk - standard.
elastic_ephemeral_disk_premium: elastic ephemeral disk - premium.
ephemeral: (retired) local disk.
ephemeral_ssd: (retired) local SSD
Category.description_zh:
磁盘种类。可能值：

cloud：普通云盘。
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。 
cloud_ssd：SSD盘。
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘。
cloud_auto：ESSD AutoPL云盘。
local_ssd_pro：I/O密集型本地盘。 
local_hdd_pro：吞吐密集型本地盘。
cloud_essd_entry：ESSD Entry云盘。
elastic_ephemeral_disk_standard：弹性临时盘-标准版。
elastic_ephemeral_disk_premium：弹性临时盘-高级版。
ephemeral：（已停售）本地盘。
ephemeral_ssd：（已停售）本地SSD盘

DeleteAutoSnapshot.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic snapshots are deleted when the disk is released. Valid values:

true: Automatic snapshots are deleted when the disk is released.
false: Automatic snapshots are retained when the disk is released.

Snapshots created by calling [CreateSnapshot]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25524.html） or by using the console are not affected by this parameter and are always retained
DeleteAutoSnapshot.description_zh:
是否同时删除自动快照。可能值：

true：删除云盘上的快照。
false：保留云盘上的快照。

通过[CreateSnapshot]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25524.html）或者在控制台创建的快照，不受这个参数的影响，会始终保留

DeleteWithInstance.description_en:
Indicates whether the disk is released when the associated instance is released. Valid values:

true: The disk is released when the associated instance is released.
false: The disk is retained when the associated instance is released
DeleteWithInstance.description_zh:
是否随实例释放。可能值：

true：释放实例时，这块磁盘随实例一起释放。
false：释放实例时，这块磁盘保留不释放

DetachedTime.description_en: The time when the disk was last detached
DetachedTime.description_zh: 该磁盘最后一次卸载时间

Device.description_en:
The device name of the disk on the instance to which the disk is attached, such as /dev/xvdb. Note:

This parameter has a value only when the Status parameter is set to In_use or Detaching. In other cases, this parameter is empty.

For a disk with the multi-attach feature enabled, this value is always empty. You can view all attachment information of the disk from the Attachment list in the response.

This parameter is being deprecated. To improve backward compatibility, do not use this parameter
Device.description_zh:
磁盘挂载的实例的设备名，例如/dev/xvdb。您需要注意：

该参数仅在`Status`参数值为`In_use`或`Detaching`时才有值，其他状态时为空。

对于开启多重挂载特性的云盘，该值始终为空。您可以通过返回的`Attachment`对象组成的列表，查看云盘所涉及的所有挂载信息。

该参数即将停止使用，为提高代码兼容性，建议您尽量不要使用该参数

DiskChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the disk. Valid values:

PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
DiskChargeType.description_zh:
磁盘的计费方式。可能值：

PrePaid：包年包月。
PostPaid：按量付费

EnableAutoSnapshot.description_en:
Indicates whether the automatic snapshot policy feature is enabled for the disk.


This parameter is deprecated. After a disk is created, the automatic snapshot policy feature is enabled by default. You only need to associate an automatic snapshot policy with the disk
EnableAutoSnapshot.description_zh:
云盘是否启用自动快照策略功能。


该参数已弃用。创建后的云盘默认启用自动快照策略功能，您只需要为云盘绑定自动快照策略即可正常使用

EnableAutomatedSnapshotPolicy.description_en: Indicates whether an automatic snapshot policy is applied to the disk
EnableAutomatedSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 云盘是否设置了自动快照策略

Encrypted.description_en: Indicates whether the disk is encrypted

ExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the subscription disk
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 包年包月磁盘的过期时间

IOPS.description_en: The maximum number of read/write (I/O) operations per second. Unit: operations/s
IOPS.description_zh: 每秒读写（I/O）操作的次数上限，单位：次/s

IOPSRead.description_en: The maximum number of read operations per second. Unit: operations/s
IOPSRead.description_zh: 每秒读操作的次数上限，单位：次/s

IOPSWrite.description_en: The maximum number of write operations per second. Unit: operations/s
IOPSWrite.description_zh: 每秒写操作的次数上限，单位：次/s

ImageId.description_en: The ID of the image used to create the ECS instance. This parameter has a value only for disks created from an image. Otherwise, this parameter is empty. If the image used to create the disk is deleted, this parameter is empty
ImageId.description_zh: 创建ECS实例时使用的镜像ID，只有通过镜像创建的云盘才有值，否则为空。当创建磁盘的镜像被删除后，该值为空

InstanceId.description_en:
The instance ID of the instance to which the disk is attached. Note:

This parameter has a value only when the Status parameter is set to In_use or Detaching. In other cases, this parameter is empty.

For a disk with the multi-attach attribute enabled, this value is always empty. You can view all attachment information of the disk from the Attachment list in the response
InstanceId.description_zh:
磁盘挂载的实例ID。您需要注意：

该参数值仅在`Status`参数值为`In_use`或`Detaching`时才有值，其他状态时为空。

对于开启多重挂载特性的云盘，该值始终为空。您可以通过返回的`Attachment`对象组成的列表，查看云盘所涉及的所有挂载信息

KMSKeyId.description_en: The ID of the Key Management Service (KMS) key used by the disk

MountInstanceNum.description_en: The number of instances to which the Shared Block Storage device is attached
MountInstanceNum.description_zh: 共享存储挂载的实例数量

MountInstance.description_en: The collection of information about the instances to which the Shared Block Storage device is attached
MountInstance.description_zh: 共享存储挂载到实例上的信息集合

items.description_en: The information about the instance to which the Shared Block Storage device is attached
items.description_zh: 共享存储挂载到实例上的信息

AttachedTime.description_en: The time when the disk was attached. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC+0
AttachedTime.description_zh: 挂载时间。按照[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

Device.description_en: The mount point of the disk

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the instance to which the disk is attached

MultiAttach.description_en: Indicates whether the multi-attach feature is enabled for the disk
MultiAttach.description_zh: 云盘是否开启了多重挂载特性

OperationLock.description_en: The list of reasons why the disk is locked

items.description_en: The reason why the disk is locked

LockReason.description_en: The reason why the disk is locked for security reasons
LockReason.description_zh: 磁盘被安全锁定的原因

PerformanceLevel.description_en:
The performance level (PL) of the ESSD. Valid values:

PL0: A single disk can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL1: A single disk can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL2: A single disk can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL3: A single disk can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS
PerformanceLevel.description_zh:
ESSD云盘的性能等级。可能值：

PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万。
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万。
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万。
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万

Placement.description_en:
The collection of data storage locations.

This field is returned only when AdditionalAttributes.N is set to Placement in the request.

Only regional ESSD (cloud_regional_disk_auto) disks have valid values
Placement.description_zh:
数据存放地集合。

只有入参指定 `AdditionalAttributes.N = Placement` 时，才会返回该字段。

当前仅有ESSD 同城冗余类型（cloud_regional_disk_auto）磁盘具有有效值

ZoneIds.description_en: The list of zones where the data is stored
ZoneIds.description_zh: 实际数据存放的可用区列表

Portable.description_en: Indicates whether the disk is removable

ProductCode.description_en: The product code of the Alibaba Cloud Marketplace image

ProvisionedIops.description_en:
The provisioned read/write IOPS of the ESSD AutoPL disk. Valid values: 0 to min{50000, 1000 × Capacity - Baseline performance}.
Baseline performance = min{1800 + 50 × Capacity, 50000}.

This parameter is supported only when DiskCategory is set to cloud_auto. For more information, see [ESSD AutoPL disks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html）
ProvisionedIops.description_zh:
ESSD AutoPL云盘预配置的读写IOPS。可能值：0~min{50000, 1000*容量-基准性能}。
基准性能=min{1,800+50*容量, 50,000}。

当`DiskCategory`取值为`cloud_auto`时才支持设置该参数。更多信息，请参见[ESSD AutoPL云盘]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html）

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the disk

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the disk belongs
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 磁盘所在的企业资源组ID

SerialNumber.description_en: The serial number of the disk

Size.description_en: The size of the disk. Unit: GiB

SourceSnapshotId.description_en:
The ID of the snapshot used to create the disk.

If no snapshot was specified when the disk was created, this parameter is empty. If the snapshot used to create the disk is deleted, this parameter is empty
SourceSnapshotId.description_zh:
创建云盘使用的快照ID。

如果创建云盘时，没有指定快照，则该参数值为空。如果创建云盘的快照被删除，该参数值为空

Status.description_en:
The status of the disk. Valid values:

In_use: in use.
Available: to be attached.
Attaching: being attached.
Detaching: being detached.
Creating: being created.
ReIniting: being initialized
Status.description_zh:
磁盘状态。可能值：

In_use：使用中。
Available：待挂载。
Attaching：挂载中 。
Detaching：卸载中。
Creating：创建中。
ReIniting：初始化中

StorageClusterId.description_en: The ID of the dedicated block storage cluster to which the disk belongs. If the disk belongs to a public block storage cluster, this value is empty
StorageClusterId.description_zh: 云盘所属的专属块存储集群ID。如果您的云盘在公共云块存储集群中，则该返回值为空

StorageSetId.description_en: The ID of the storage set

StorageSetPartitionNumber.description_en: The maximum number of partitions in the storage set
StorageSetPartitionNumber.description_zh: 存储集中的最大分区数量

Tag.description_en: The collection of tags of the disk

Throughput.description_en: The amount of data that can be transferred per unit of time. Unit: MB/s
Throughput.description_zh: 单位时间内可以成功传输的数据数量，单位：MB/s

ThroughputRead.description_en: The amount of data that the system can read per unit of time. Unit: MB/s
ThroughputRead.description_zh: 单位时间内系统可以成功读取的数据数量，单位：MB/s

ThroughputWrite.description_en: The amount of data that the system can write per unit of time. Unit: MB/s
ThroughputWrite.description_zh: 单位时间内系统可以成功写入的数据数量，单位：MB/s

Type.description_en:
The type of the disk. Valid values:

system: system disk.
data: data disk
Type.description_zh:
磁盘类型。可能值：

system：系统盘。
data：数据盘

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the disk

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned in this call
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值

PageNumber.description_en: This parameter will be offline soon. Use NextToken and MaxResults for paging operations
PageNumber.description_zh: 该参数即将下线，推荐您使用参数 `NextToken `与 `MaxResults `完成分页查询操作

PageSize.description_en: This parameter will be offline soon. Use NextToken and MaxResults for paging operations
PageSize.description_zh: 该参数即将下线，推荐您使用参数 `NextToken `与 `MaxResults `完成分页查询操作

TotalCount.description_en:
The total number of entries returned.
When you use the MaxResults and NextToken parameters for paging, the returned TotalCount value is invalid
TotalCount.description_zh:
查询结果总条数。
使用`MaxResults`和`NextToken`参数进行分页查询时，返回的`TotalCount`参数值无效
